notes.title: Play 4 Hours of Like a Dragon Gaiden for Free Until October 28
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224939/e6bfd1ffa57788690e58f33a5b50811ba572d507.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375550/Like_a_Dragon_Gaiden_The_Man_Who_Erased_His_Name/ 

Now until October 28th, you can play Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name for 4 hours, absolutely free! 

After finishing the trial, don’t forget to pick up the game for 50% off during the Like a Dragon/Yakuza Franchise Sale happening now until November 7! 

[previewyoutube=K03jnW9bFXk;full][/previewyoutube]

ERASE YOUR PAST TO PROTECT YOUR FUTURE

Once a legendary yakuza, Kazuma Kiryu faked his own death and abandoned his name for the sake of protecting his family. Now, he is thrust into conflict by a mysterious figure attempting to drive him out of hiding. Under the codename “Joryu,” Kiryu embarks on a gripping action narrative with bone-shattering combat in vibrant locations filled with exciting characters and activities.

Dynamically switch between the Yakuza and Agent fighting styles in visceral melee combat. With the Yakuza style, strike fear into enemies by unleashing wildly aggressive moves powered by Kiryu’s unparalleled strength and flair. Or up the ante with the Agent style by delivering blows with absolute speed and precision, while using an array of high-tech gadgets like electrified bind wires to stun enemies then send them flying.

Whether you're brawling in the secret Battle arena, singing a new karaoke song, enjoying a drink at the live-action cabaret club, or racing in the pocket circuit, the world offers a variety of immersive experiences.

notes.title: Like a Dragon Gaiden 1.12 Patch Update
notes.content:
Hello RGG Fans!

Thank you for playing Like a Dragon Gaiden
Patch 1.12 is now live with the following fixes and improvements:

•	Fixed an issue with the game running at double speed in certain environments.
•	Adjusted the bird’s eye camera view while playing pool.
•	Graphics settings in the main game now carry over to the Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth Special Trial Version.
•	Fixed an issue with the display while using Intel Arc.
•	When anti-aliasing is set to “NVIDIA DLAA” in the graphics settings, sharpness can now be adjusted using the “NVIDIA DLSS Sharpness” slider.
•	Fixed various other issues.

We appreciate your support and patience while our team addresses these known issues.

Please continue to share any bugs you encounter via the Official Bug Thread.

- RGG Community Team -
